title: Qt: Lua Debugger: Polish context menus, gutter and shortcuts
description:
Add right-click menus on Files (Open, Reveal in File Manager, Copy
Path) and Stack Trace (Open Source, Copy Location), and extend the
Variables menu with Copy Name & Value and Copy Path.

The editor right-click Add Watch is no longer gated on the paused
state and falls back to the Lua identifier under the caret when no
text is selected, so a single right-click on a variable name is
enough to watch it.

Shift+click on the editor gutter on a line with no breakpoint now
adds a disabled breakpoint so the line can be pre-armed without
paying the line-hook cost. Ctrl+Shift+F9 now triggers Remove All
Breakpoints from anywhere in the dialog.

Ping #21193

AI-Assisted: yes
